review:
Starlight Princess with Super Scatters. In the base game, multipliers up to 500x can land and add together at the end of each tumble sequence.

Four or more scatters start the bonus, where every multiplier on a winning tumble joins a running total. Trigger it with one to four Super Scatters and you also get an instant 100x to 50,000x. Plays like Gates of Olympus Super Scatter with an anime theme. 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
